description:
Edits a notification that has not been sent: subject, content, type and language. Requires notificationRequestId and caseFileId. `content` must be valid HTML — plain text is accepted by the API but does NOT render on the recipient landing page. Supported tags only:

, , ,

  • ,
    1. ; no other tags and no CSS. Keep `subject` to plain ASCII (no em dashes, no smart quotes), 100 characters maximum. TESTED: once the notification has been sent the API rejects this with 403 Forbidden, so editing only works before the send. To change which case file it belongs to use notification_request_case_file_move — this tool does not move it.
name: notification_request_update
